d.s: Sikalastic-827 HT is a modified, expanding copolymer, hot-melt pellet adhesive. It bonds mastic asphalt, stone mastic asphalt and asphalt concrete to Sika bridge deck waterproofing systems.
a: Provides a bond between Sika spray applied waterproofing membrane and asphalt overlay
Provides a mechanical key due to expansion when in contact with hot asphalt
Develops good bond and shear strength performance
us: Broadcasting onto wet Sikalastic-8902 Broadcasting onto wet SikaCor HM Mastic
